def summarize(jobs):
    counts = {"new":0, "applied":0, "rejected":0, "other":0}
    for job in jobs:
        status = job.get("status")
        if status is None:
            continue
        s = str(status).strip().lower()
        if s == "new":
            counts["new"] += 1
        elif s == "applied":
            counts["applied"] += 1
        elif s == "rejected":
            counts["rejected"] += 1
        else:
            counts["other"] += 1
    return counts
